t: A Haunting: Hungry Ghosts
d: In Taiwan, an American family refuses to believe there are ghosts in their house.

t: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 7
d: This episode includes: General Wayne Inn, Paisley Hat & UD, Son of Sam Pt. 2 and Mrs. Millionaire & UD.

t: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 8
d: This episode includes: Missing Mom, Update: Personals, San Quentin Escape & UD, Medford Millions Pts. 1 & 2 & UD and Cardboard Killer & UD.

t: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 9
d: This episode includes: Halloween Party Death, Father/Son & UD, Priest Killer and Rock of Fortune.

t: The Haunting Of. . .: Gina Gershon
d: Gina ("Face/Off", "Bound") and Kim revisit Gina's old apartment from her days as a student at NYU. Kim and Gina explore the apartment building.

t: The Haunting Of. . .: Fairuza Balk
d: After having a traumatizing experience at her studio, Fairuza (American History X, The Craft) wants to know more about the ghosts that live there.

t: The Haunting Of. . .: Barry Bostwick
d: Barry and Kim come face to face with the spirit activity that haunts the home forcing Barry to resolve the personal issues that continue to haunt him to this day.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Rise of the Fourth Reich (Nazi's in America)
st: The Rise of the Fourth Reich (Nazi's in America)
d: The Allies defeated the Axis Powers on the battlefield, but did they actually win the war? Richard interviews several alternative historians who say that while the German Army may have surrendered in 1945, the Nazi's never officially did.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Did Elvis Fake His Death?
d: A serious investigation of the long-held theory that Elvis Presley faked his death in August 1977.  Jokes of Elvis sightings in Kalamazoo aside, there is a considerable volume of evidence to suggest Elvis may not have left the building

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Manchurian Candidates
d: Several prominent researchers in the field provide a short history of Mind Control experimentation beginning with the Nazis through to the CIA's infamous MK Ultra program.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Framing of Sirhan, Sirhan
d: Was Presidential hopeful, Robert F. Kennedy really killed by  disgruntled Palestinian Sirhan Sirhan as we’ve been led to believe? Or was he another in a long line of Manchurian candidates, a victim of a long standing mind control program.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Past Life Regression Pt. 2
d: Richard witnesses a municipal employee in Toronto, Canada undergo a regression during which he re-experiences a previous life as a doctor in early 20 century England.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Bible Codes
d: Does the Bible contain hidden messages encoded within certain passages of the Old Testament?  Is the prophetic nature of these 'codes' proof the Bible's author is of supernatural or extraterrestrial origin?

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Journey to the Center of the Earth
st: Journey to the Center of the Earth
d: Richard interviews the expedition organizer who is planning on leading a team of scientists, filmmakers and tourists to the Arctic aboard a Russian nuclear ice-breaker in search of an entrance into the interior of our world.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
d: Richard meets members of the 9/11 Truth movement who challenge the official version of events concerning the attack on the U.S. Pentagon. Researchers present evidence to suggest the attack was perpetrated by some rogue element inside the U.S. government.

t: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
d: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

t: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
d: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

t: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
d: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

t: My Haunted House: Pest House and Sleepwalkers
d: An earthquake triggers terrifying activity in a house with a dark past. A young woman sees visions in her sleep that lead her to an abandoned hospital.

t: My Haunted House: The Whispering and Ethel
d: After returning home for her mother's funeral, a young woman is terrorized by visions from her past. A musician finds a suicide note that reveals the dark history of his new house.

t: My Haunted House: The Boy Did It and Frozen Forest
st: The Boy Did It and Frozen Forest
d: A five-year-old boy claims that his imaginary friend pushed his sister through a second story window. A newly divorced woman relives the terrifying history of the remote cabin she's rented.

t: My Ghost Story: It Watches Me While I Sleep
st: It Watches Me While I Sleep
d: The suburban house of two young cousins is filled with scary encounters after a demonic ceramic giraffe is brought into their home.

t: My Ghost Story: The Axe Murderer
d: An unknown axe murderer still stalks a family he brutally murdered a century ago and then next-door a spirit with a deadly secret haunts a young couple. An off the beaten path bar is stocked with other worldly spirits.

t: My Ghost Story: An Entity in Bed
d: An entity jumps into a woman's bed and lies down beside her; two sisters' ghosts roam a Civil War-era house; a castle built on an old Indian burial ground is haunted by its original owner; and more.
